title: SocioBoom
description: A social media growth and scheduling platform — post scheduling on a shared content calendar, team collaboration, and three AI-powered growth tools: Review Poster, Pain-Point Discovery, and Content Strategy.

title: Arete
description: A gamified self-development Android app inspired by Solo Leveling — daily quests across Spiritual, Physical, and Mental pillars, XP, streaks, and ranks from F to SSS.

title: BTP (Big Tech Prep)
description: An open source, AI-powered interview prep platform — semantic job matching, a Socratic AI coach for DSA practice, and live mock interviews across behavioral, technical, and system design formats.

title: UNILAG Map
description: Built an interactive University of Lagos map using React and Canvas. Applied Dijkstra's algorithm for optimal pathfinding, providing a foundation for motion planning and coordination logic in autonomous systems.

title: Project Management System
description: Developed a system using Next.js and Express.js with Redis caching for faster project loading and drag-and-drop organization.

title: NodeJS Database Backup Utility
description: Created a CLI tool to back up PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, simplifying database maintenance and recovery workflows.

title: ROS Navigation & Sensor Integration
description: Configured Ubuntu/ROS and deployed TurtleBot3 in Gazebo simulation, implementing autonomous environment detection and movement behaviors with sensors and LCD output on Arduino/ESP32.

title: HTTP Server from Scratch
description: Built a fully functional HTTP server in Go from the ground up, implementing TCP connection handling, request parsing, and response formatting without external frameworks.

title: Nextvibe
description: A social event platform — discover and attend events, create postcards with digital backdrops, compete in games, and connect with other attendees in real time.

title: Munakalati (Muna)
description: The site for Muna, a nonprofit building Africa's children's media ecosystem — literacy and publishing programs, a magazine, TV, and studio arm, plus donate/volunteer/partner pathways, all managed through an embedded Sanity Studio.

title: Kingsley Iheme — Ghostwriter Portfolio
description: An editorial portfolio and content site for a ghostwriter and consultant — self-managed blog and book catalog via an embedded Sanity Studio, with Cal.com for consulting bookings.

title: Direct Debit API Sandbox
description: A Direct Debit API sandbox with end-to-end testing, built during a software engineering internship at IT Consortium (Ghana) — not a Spectroniq project. Deployed via a CI/CD pipeline to AWS EC2.

title: Spectroniq Website
description: The marketing site for Spectroniq Limited — products, portfolio, and services, all data-driven so new work ships without touching the layout code.

title: json-healer
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript utility that repairs malformed JSON from LLM output — markdown fences, chatter, trailing commas, truncated structures, smart quotes — and returns valid, typed parsed JSON.

title: Gees Arise
description: An accountability app for a small, tight-knit friend circle — set personal tasks, attach proof, and let your circle audit whether you actually did them. Miss it or fake it and you land in the Hall of Shame until the group votes you clear.

title: strictenv
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript micro-library that turns process.env into a typed, validated, auto-coercing object — halts the process with a readable terminal report if anything required is missing or invalid, instead of failing later at runtime.
